description: This file defines the class BlockingBiConsumer, a utility class implementing BiConsumer that blocks until result or timeout occurs, used in testing asynchronous code.

classes.name: BlockingBiConsumer
classes.description: A BiConsumer implementation that blocks until a result or timeout occurs, used to synchronize asynchronous operations for testing.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Stores the result value and throwable, then decrements the latch to indicate completion.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Waits up to 2 seconds for the latch, then returns the stored value or throws an exception if an error occurred.
